title: Chair Committee
tagline: Put bad design on top of itself.
concept: Stack visibly ill-designed chairs into a surprisingly dignified tower, one deliberate drop at a time.
core_loop: Study the next chair, move and rotate it over the tower, then drop it and watch it settle; each 5–15 second placement stays satisfying because strange silhouettes create new balancing choices and recoverable wobbles.
mechanics: Controls: drag or use left/right arrows to position, tap large rotate buttons or press Q/E to turn, and tap Drop or press Space to release.; Win/lose: place six chairs without one falling off the platform to clear a round; a collapse ends the round with an instant retry.; Scoring: earn one point per secured chair plus clearly previewed height bonuses for crossing marked lines, with the longest clean tower saved.
feedback: A successful chair lands with a solid thunk, briefly glows green, and raises the score; a failure produces a clattering collapse, red platform flash, and dry verdict; a near-miss creaks, wobbles in slow readable arcs, and flashes its strained contact points amber before either settling or falling.
difficulty: The first round uses a wide platform, chunky symmetrical chairs, a landing shadow, and forgiving contact snapping; later rounds remain untimed but use narrower platforms, taller targets, and curated asymmetrical chairs while always previewing the next two pieces.
